notes.note: The brief described deferral as the only behavioural difference between I and V. As declared in plan_addendum_2.json it is not: under I pending hits are verified in value order (under S, constant value, so history_mean order) rather than screen-label order; under S, I orders new screens by p_s rather than history_mean; in the physical version I divides by cost. Deferrals were in fact 0 in every measurement-version cell and 1.5 hit-rounds in each physical I cell, so the observed scheduler effects come mostly from these ordering differences.
deferred_by_priority counts hit-rounds (a hit deferred in two rounds counts twice); deferred_hits counts distinct hits. Both are means over SV and VS summed over lines.
